name: Ransomware Response Playbook
description: Immediate containment and recovery procedure for ransomware attack on SCADA node

actions.description: Immediately isolate the compromised node from the SCADA network to prevent lateral movement
Block the identified Command and Control server IP at perimeter firewall
Capture volatile memory from affected node before any remediation to preserve forensic evidence
Isolate backup systems to prevent ransomware from encrypting backups
Dispatch critical alert to SOC team and facility management with incident details
Open P1 incident ticket in SOC ticketing system with full forensic context

recovery_steps: Verify backup integrity before any restore operation
Rebuild compromised node from verified golden image
Rotate all credentials associated with affected systems
Scan all adjacent nodes for indicators of compromise
Update firewall rules based on observed C2 infrastructure
Submit malware samples to threat intelligence sharing platforms
